| 11 | 11.1 Information on toxicological effects Acute toxicity Shall not be classified as acutely toxic. | Není klasifikována jako akutně toxická. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as corrosive/irritant to skin. | Není klasifikována jako žíravá/dráždivá pro kůži. |

| 11 | Shall not be classified as presenting an aspiration hazard. | Toxicita pro specifické cílové orgány - opakovaná expozice Není klasifikována jako toxická pro specifické cílové orgány (opakovaná expozice). |
| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed vomiting, abdominal pain, nausea, Causes damage to liver through prolonged or repeated exposure if swallowed, loss of righting reflex, and ataxia Causes serious eye irritation • If inhaled drowsiness, narcosis, vertigo, breathing difficulties, Inebriation Prolonged or repeated skin contact may cause removal of natural fat from the skin resulting in dermatitis (skin inflammation) • Other information Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\mathsf { f } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ . | Není klasifikována jako představující nebezpečnost při vdechnutí. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Popis první pomoci Obecné poznámky Kontaminovaný oděv svlékněte. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Zajistěte přísun čerstvého vzduchu. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Ve všech případech pochybností, nebo když příznaky přetrvávají, vyhledejte lékařskou pomoc. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Opláchněte kůži vodou/osprchujte. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Ve všech případech pochybností, nebo když příznaky přetrvávají, vyhledejte lékařskou pomoc. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | Oční víčka držte roztažená a vypláchněte velkým množstvím čisté, tekoucí vody, po dobu 10 minut. |
| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Při podráždění očí vyhledat očního lékaře. |

| 5 | Places which are not ventilated, e.g. | Místa která nejsou větrané, např.nevětraný prostor pod úrovní země: například příkopy, potrubí a šachty jsou obzvláště náchylné na přítomnost hořlavých látek nebo směsí. |
| 5 | unventilated below ground level areas such as trenches, conduits and shafts, are particularly prone to the presence of flammable substances or mixtures. | Páry jsou těžší než vzduch, šíří se při zemi a vytvářejí se vzduchem výbušné směsi. |
| 5 | Vapours are heavier than air, spread along floors and form explosive mixtures with air. | Páry mohou tvořit výbušnou směs se vzduchem. |

| 5 | In case of fire may be liberated: Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | Haste pomocí běžných preventivních opatření z přiměřené vzdálenosti. |
| 5 | Fight fire with normal precautions from a reasonable distance. | Použijte samostatný dýchací přístroj. |
| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | 6.1 Opatření na ochranu osob, ochranné prostředky a nouzové postupy Pro pracovníky kromě pracovníků zasahujících v případě nouze Zabraňte kontaktu s kůží, očima a oděvem. |
| 6 | Do not breathe vapour/spray. | Nevdechujte páry/aerosoly. |
| 6 | Avoidance of ignition sources. | Zamezení zdrojů zapálení. |

| 7 | Measures to prevent fire as well as aerosol and dust generation Keep away from sources of ignition - No smoking. | Opatření pro zamezení požáru a tvorby aerosolu a prachu Uchovávejte mimo dosah zdrojů zapálení - Zákaz kouření. |

| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed vomiting, abdominal pain, nausea, Causes damage to liver through prolonged or repeated exposure if swallowed, loss of righting reflex, and ataxia Causes serious eye irritation • If inhaled drowsiness, narcosis, vertigo, breathing difficulties, Inebriation Prolonged or repeated skin contact may cause removal of natural fat from the skin resulting in dermatitis (skin inflammation) • Other information Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\mathsf { f } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ 11.3 Information on other hazards There is no additional information. | Není klasifikována jako představující nebezpečnost při vdechnutí. |

| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | 6.1 Opatření na ochranu osob, ochranné prostředky a nouzové postupy Pro pracovníky kromě pracovníků zasahujících v případě nouze Zabraňte kontaktu s kůží, očima a oděvem. |
| 6 | Do not breathe vapour/spray. | Nevdechujte páry/aerosoly. |
| 6 | Avoidance of ignition sources. | Zamezení zdrojů zapálení. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Bei Auftreten von Beschwerden oder in Zweifelsfällen ärztlichen Rat einholen. |

| 4 | In case of contact with eyes flush immediately with plenty of flowing water for 10 to 15 minutes holding eyelids apart and consult an ophthalmologist. | Nach Berührung mit den Augen Bei Berührung mit den Augen sofort bei geöffnetem Lidspalt 10 bis 15 Minuten mit fließendem Wasser spülen und Augenarzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Rinse mouth with water (only if the person is conscious). | Mund mit Wasser ausspülen (nur wenn Verunfallter bei Bewusstsein ist). |
| 4 | In case of accident or unwellness, seek medical advice immediately (show directions for use or safety data sheet if possible). | Bei Unfall oder Unwohlsein sofort Arzt hinzuziehen (wenn möglich, Betriebsanweisung oder Sicherheitsdatenblatt vorzeigen). |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Bei Auftreten von Beschwerden oder in Zweifelsfällen ärztlichen Rat einholen. |

| 4 | In case of skin irritation, consult a physician. | Bei Hautreizungen Arzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | In case of contact with eyes flush immediately with plenty of flowing water for 10 to 15 minutes holding eyelids apart and consult an ophthalmologist. | Nach Berührung mit den Augen Bei Berührung mit den Augen sofort bei geöffnetem Lidspalt 10 bis 15 Minuten mit fließendem Wasser spülen und Augenarzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Rinse mouth with water (only if the person is conscious). | Mund mit Wasser ausspülen (nur wenn Verunfallter bei Bewusstsein ist). |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |

| 7 | Incompatible materials: see section 10. | Gegen äußere Einwirkungen schützen, wie Feuchtigkeit, Luft-/Sauerstoffzutritt, UV-Einstrahlung/Sonnenlicht Bewahren Sie Gefahrstoffe, die gesundheitsgefährliche Dämpfe abgeben möglichst an dauerabgesaugten Orten auf. |
| 7 | Protect against external exposure, such as humidity, contact with air/oxygen, UV-radiation/sunlight Keep any substance that emits harmful vapours or gases in a place that allows these to be permanently extracted. | Spezielle Anforderungen an Lagerräume oder -behälter Empfohlene Lagerungstemperatur: $1 5 - 2 5 ^ { \circ } C$ 7.3 Spezifische Endanwendungen Es liegen keine Informationen vor. |

| 8 | Skin protection • hand protection Wear suitable gloves. | 8.2 Begrenzung und Überwachung der Exposition Individuelle Schutzmaßnahmen (persönliche Schutzausrüstung) Augen-/Gesichtsschutz Geeignete Schutzhandschuhe tragen. |
| 8 | Chemical protection gloves are suitable, which are tested according to EN 374. | Geeignet ist ein nach EN 374 geprüfter Chemikalienschutzhandschuh. |
| 8 | For special purposes, it is recommended to check the resistance to chemicals of the protective gloves mentioned above together with the supplier of these gloves. | Es wird empfohlen, die Chemikalienbeständigkeit der oben genannten Schutzhandschuhe für spezielle Anwendungen mit dem Handschuhhersteller abzuklären. |
| 8 | The times are approximate values from measurements at $2 2 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ and permanent contact. | Die Zeitangaben sind Richtwerte aus Messungen bei $\bar { 2 } 2 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ und dauerhaftem Kontakt. |
| 8 | Increased temperatures due to heated substances, body heat etc. | Erhöhte Temperaturen durch erwärmte Substanzen, Körperwärme etc. |
| 8 | and a reduction of the effective layer thickness by stretching can lead to a considerable reduction of the breakthrough time. | und eine Verminderung der effektiven Schichtstärke durch Dehnung können zu einer erheblichen Verringerung der Durchbruchzeit führen. |
| 8 | If in doubt, contact manufacturer. | Im Zweifelsfall Hersteller ansprechen. |
| 8 | 1.5 times larger / smaller layer thickness, the respective breakthrough time is doubled / halved. | 1,5-fach größeren/kleineren Schichtdicke verdoppelt/halbiert sich die jeweilige Durchbruchzeit. |
| 8 | The data apply only to the pure substance. | Die Daten gelten nur für den Reinstoff. |
| 8 | When transferred to substance mixtures, they may only be considered as a guide. | Bei Übertragung auf Substanzgemische dürfen sie nur als Orientierungshilfe angesehen werden. |

| 8 | Preventive skin protection (barrier creams/ointments) is recommended. | Vorbeugender Hautschutz (Schutzcremes/Salben) wird empfohlen. |

| 11 | Harmful if inhaled. | Gesundheitsschädlich bei Einatmen. |

| 11 | May cause an allergic skin reaction. | Schwere Augenschädigung/Augenreizung Verursacht schwere Augenreizung. |

| 11 | Shall not be classified as a reproductive toxicant. | Ist nicht als reproduktionstoxisch einzustufen. |

| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed nausea, diarrhoea, vomiting • If in eyes • If inhaled irritant effects, cough, Dyspnoea • If on skin has degreasing effect on the skin, Frequently or prolonged contact with skin may cause dermal irritation, May produce an allergic reaction, pruritis, localised redness • Other information Other adverse effects: Headache, Agitation, Spasms, Dizziness, Unconsciousness Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $) \mathsf { f } \ge 0 , 1 \%$ . | Spezifische Zielorgan-Toxizität bei wiederholter Exposition Ist nicht als spezifisch zielorgantoxisch (wiederholte Exposition) einzustufen. |
| 11 | 11.3 Information on other hazards There is no additional information. | Ist nicht als aspirationsgefährlich einzustufen. |
| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Bei Auftreten von Beschwerden oder in Zweifelsfällen ärztlichen Rat einholen. |
| 4 | After contact with skin, wash immediately with plenty of water. | Nach Kontakt mit der Haut Bei Berührung mit der Haut sofort abwaschen mit viel Wasser. |
| 4 | In case of skin reactions, consult a physician. | Bei Hautreaktionen Arzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Nach Berührung mit den Augen Augenlider geöffnet halten und mindestens 10 Minuten lang reichlich mit sauberem, fliessendem Wasser spülen. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | Bei Augenreizung einen Augenarzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Rinse mouth with water (only if the person is conscious). | Mund mit Wasser ausspülen (nur wenn Verunfallter bei Bewusstsein ist). |
| 4 | 4.2 Most important symptoms and effects, both acute and delayed Irritation, Nausea, Diarrhoea, Vomiting, Agitation, Headache, Cough, Dyspnoea, Spasms, Dizziness, Unconsciousness, Allergic reactions 4.3 Indication of any immediate medical attention and special treatment needed | 4.2 Wichtigste akute und verzögert auftretende Symptome und Wirkungen Reizung, Übelkeit, Durchfall, Erbrechen, Erregung, Kopfschmerzen, Husten, Atemnot, Krämpfe, Benommenheit, Bewusstlosigkeit, Allergische Reaktionen 4.3 Hinweise auf ärztliche Soforthilfe oder Spezialbehandlung |
| 5 | 5.1 Extinguishing media Suitable extinguishing media co-ordinate firefighting measures to the fire surroundings! | Löschmassnahmen auf die Umgebung abstimmen! |
| 5 | water spray, alcohol resistant foam, dry extinguishing powder, BC-powder, carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ Unsuitable extinguishing media water jet 5.2 Special hazards arising from the substance or mixture Combustible. | Sprühwasser, alkoholbeständiger Schaum, Trockenlöschpulver, BC-Pulver, Kohlendioxid (CO2) 5.2 Besondere vom Stoff oder Gemisch ausgehende Gefahren Brennbar. |
| 5 | Vapours are heavier than air, spread along floors and form explosive mixtures with air. | Dämpfe sind schwerer als Luft, breiten sich am Boden aus und bilden mit Luft ein explosionsfähiges Gemisch. |
| 5 | In case of fire may be liberated: Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | Im Brandfall können entstehen: Kohlenmonoxid (CO), Kohlendioxid (CO2) 5.3 Hinweise für die Brandbekämpfung Explosions- und Brandgase nicht einatmen. |
| 5 | Fight fire with normal precautions from a reasonable distance. | Brandbekämpfung mit üblichen Vorsichtsmassnahmen aus angemessener Entfernung. |
| 5 | Wear self-contained breathing apparatus. | Umgebungsluftunabhängiges Atemschutzgerät tragen. |
| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | 6.1 Personenbezogene Vorsichtsmaßnahmen, Schutzausrüstungen und in Notfällen anzuwendende Verfahren Nicht für Notfälle geschultes Personal Kontakt mit Haut, Augen und Kleidung vermeiden. |
| 6 | Do not breathe vapour/spray. | Dampf/Aerosol nicht einatmen. |
| 6 | Keep away from drains, surface and ground water. | Das Eindringen in die Kanalisation oder in Oberflächen- und Grundwasser verhindern. |
| 6 | Retain contaminated washing water and dispose of it. | Verunreinigtes Waschwasser zurückhalten und entsorgen. |
| 6 | 6.3 Methods and material for containment and cleaning up Advice on how to contain a spill Covering of drains. | 6.3 Methoden und Material für Rückhaltung und Reinigung Hinweise wie verschüttete Materialien an der Ausbreitung gehindert werden können Abdecken der Kanalisationen. |
| 6 | Advice on how to clean up a spill Absorb with liquid-binding material (sand, diatomaceous earth, acid- or universal binding agents). | Hinweise wie die Reinigung im Fall von Verschütten erfolgen kann Mit flüssigkeitsbindendem Material (Sand, Kieselgur, Säurebinder, Universalbinder) aufnehmen. |
| 6 | Other information relating to spills and releases Place in appropriate containers for disposal. | Weitere Angaben betreffend Verschütten und Freisetzung In geeigneten Behältern zur Entsorgung bringen. |
| 6 | Ventilate affected area. | Den betroffenen Bereich belüften. |
| 6 | 6.4 Reference to other sections | 6.4 Verweis auf andere Abschnitte |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Bei Auftreten von Beschwerden oder in Zweifelsfällen ärztlichen Rat einholen. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Nach Kontakt mit der Haut Haut mit Wasser abwaschen/duschen. |

| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Mund ausspülen. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Bei Auftreten von Beschwerden oder in Zweifelsfällen ärztlichen Rat einholen. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Nach Kontakt mit der Haut Haut mit Wasser abwaschen/duschen. |
| 4 | In case of skin irritation, consult a physician. | Bei Hautreizungen Arzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Nach Berührung mit den Augen Augenlider geöffnet halten und mindestens 10 Minuten lang reichlich mit sauberem, fließendem Wasser spülen. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | Bei Augenreizung einen Augenarzt aufsuchen. |
| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Mund ausspülen. |

| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Mund ausspülen. |

| 5 | Wear self-contained breathing apparatus. | Umgebungsluftunabhängiges Atemschutzgerät tragen. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | Für Frischluft sorgen. |

| 5 | In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | 5.3 Hinweise für die Brandbekämpfung Explosions- und Brandgase nicht einatmen. |

| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | In caso di dubbio o se i sintomi persistono, avvisare il medico. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | A contatto con la pelle Sciacquare la pelle/fare una doccia. |
| 4 | In case of skin irritation, consult a physician. | In caso d'irritazione cutanea consultare un dermatologo. |
| 4 | In case of contact with eyes flush immediately with plenty of flowing water for 10 to 15 minutes holding eyelids apart and consult an ophthalmologist. | A contatto con gli occhi In caso di contatto con gli occhi, sciacquare subito con acqua corrente per 10-15 minuti tenendo le palpebre aperte e consultare un oftalmologo. |
| 4 | Rinse mouth with water (only if the person is conscious). | Sciacquare la bocca con acqua (solamente se l'infortunato è cosciente). |
| 4 | In case of accident or unwellness, seek medical advice immediately (show directions for use or safety data sheet if possible). | In caso d' incidente o di malessere consultare immediatamente il medico (se possibile, mostrargli l'etichetta). |
| 4 | 4.2 Most important symptoms and effects, both acute and delayed Vomiting, Irritation, Risk of serious damage to eyes, Risk of blindness, Irreversible damage to internal organs 4.3 Indication of any immediate medical attention and special treatment needed | 4.2 Principali sintomi ed effetti, sia acuti che ritardati Vomito, Irritazione, Rischio di gravi lesioni oculari, Pericolo di cecità, Danni irreversibili agli organi interni 4.3 Indicazione dell’eventuale necessità di consultare immediatamente un medico e di trattamenti speciali nulla |
| 5 | 5.1 Extinguishing media Suitable extinguishing media co-ordinate firefighting measures to the fire surroundings! | Mezzi di estinzione idonei coordinare misure antincendio nelle zone circostanti! |
| 5 | water, foam, dry extinguishing powder, ABC-powder Unsuitable extinguishing media water jet 5.2 Special hazards arising from the substance or mixture Combustible. | acqua, schiuma, polvere estinguente secca, polvere ABC Mezzi di estinzione non idonei getto d'acqua 5.2 Pericoli speciali derivanti dalla sostanza o dalla miscela Combustibile. |
| 5 | Vapours are heavier than air, spread along floors and form explosive mixtures with air. | I vapori sono più pesanti dell'aria e possono depositarsi sul pavimento e creare con l'aria miscele esplosive. |
| 5 | In case of fire may be liberated: Nitrogen oxides (NOx), Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | In caso di incendio possono svilupparsi: Ossidi di azoto (NOx), Monossido di carbonio (CO), Biossido di carbonio $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ 5.3 Raccomandazioni per gli addetti all'estinzione degli incendi In caso di incendio e/o esplosione non respirare i fumi. |
| 5 | Do not allow firefighting water to enter drains or water courses. | Impedire il riversamento dell'acqua antincendio in fognature e corsi d'acqua. |
| 5 | Fight fire with normal precautions from a reasonable distance. | Utilizzare i mezzi estinguenti con le precauzioni abituali a distanza ragionevole. |
| 5 | Wear self-contained breathing apparatus. | Indossare l'autorespiratore. |
| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Use personal protective equipment as required. | 6.1 Precauzioni personali, dispositivi di protezione e procedure in caso di emergenza Per chi non interviene direttamente Utilizzare il dispositivo di protezione individuale richiesto. |
| 6 | Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | Evitare il contatto con la pelle, gli occhi e gli indumenti. |
| 6 | Do not breathe dust. | Non respirare la polvere. |
| 6 | Keep away from drains, surface and ground water. | Tenere lontano da scarichi, acque di superficie e acque sotterranee. |
| 6 | Retain contaminated washing water and dispose of it. | Contenere le acque di lavaggio contaminate e smaltirle. |
| 6 | If substance has entered a water course or sewer, inform the responsible authority. | Se la materia è entrata in un corso d'acqua o in una fogna, informare l'Autorità Competente. |
| 6 | 6.3 Methods and material for containment and cleaning up Advice on how to contain a spill Covering of drains. | 6.3 Metodi e materiali per il contenimento e per la bonifica Raccomandazioni sulle modalità di contenimento di una fuoriuscita Copertura degli scarichi. |
| 6 | Take up mechanically. | Catturare meccanicamente. |
| 6 | Advice on how to clean up a spill Take up mechanically. | Raccomandazioni sulle modalità di bonifica di una fuoriuscita Catturare meccanicamente. |
| 6 | Control of dust. | Controllare le polveri. |
| 6 | Other information relating to spills and releases Place in appropriate containers for disposal. | Altre informazioni relative alle fuoriuscite e ai rilasci Riporre in appositi contenitori per smaltimento. |
| 6 | Ventilate affected area. | Ventilare l'area colpita. |
| 6 | 6.4 Reference to other sections | 6.4 Riferimento ad altre sezioni |
| 7 | 7.1 Precautions for safe handling Provision of sufficient ventilation. | 7.1 Precauzioni per la manipolazione sicura Predisporre un’adeguata ventilazione. |

| 7 | Avoid: Aerosol or mist formation. | Evitare di: Formazione di aerosol o di nebbia. |
| 7 | Advice on general occupational hygiene Wash hands before breaks and after work. | Lavare le mani prima delle pause e alla fine della lavorazione. |
| 7 | Keep away from food, drink and animal feedingstuffs. | Conservare lontano da alimenti o mangimi e da bevande. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Descrizione delle misure di primo soccorso Note generali Provvedere all' apporto di aria fresca. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | In caso di dubbio o se i sintomi persistono, avvisare il medico. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | A contatto con la pelle Sciacquare la pelle/fare una doccia. |
| 4 | In case of skin irritation, consult a physician. | In caso d'irritazione cutanea consultare un dermatologo. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | A contatto con gli occhi Lavare con acqua corrente per 10 minuti tenendo le palpebre aperte. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | In caso di irritazione oculare consultare l'oculista. |
| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Sciacquare la bocca. |

| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | In caso di dubbio o se i sintomi persistono, avvisare il medico. |

| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Skyll/dusj huden med vann. |
| 4 | In case of skin irritation, consult a physician. | Oppsøk lege ved hudirritasjon. |
| 4 | In case of contact with eyes flush immediately with plenty of flowing water for 10 to 15 minutes holding eyelids apart and consult an ophthalmologist. | Ved øyekontakt vaskes øynene øyeblikkelig med rennende vann i 10 til 15 minutter mens øyelokkene holdes fra hverandre, konsulter deretter en øyelege. |
| 4 | Rinse mouth with water (only if the person is conscious). | Skyll munnen med vann (bare hvis personen er ved bevissthet). |
| 4 | In case of accident or unwellness, seek medical advice immediately (show directions for use or safety data sheet if possible). | Ved uhell eller illebefinnende er omgående legebehandling nødvendig, vis etiketten om mulig. |
| 4 | 4.2 Most important symptoms and effects, both acute and delayed Vomiting, Irritation, Risk of serious damage to eyes, Risk of blindness, Irreversible damage to internal organs 4.3 Indication of any immediate medical attention and special treatment needed | 4.2 De viktigste symptomene og virkningene, både akutte og forsinkede Oppkast, Irritasjon, Fare for alvorlig øyeskade, Fare for blindhet, Irreversible skader på indre organer 4.3 Angivelse av om umiddelbar legehjelp og spesialbehandling er nødvendig |
| 5 | 5.1 Extinguishing media Suitable extinguishing media co-ordinate firefighting measures to the fire surroundings! | 5.1 Slokkingsmidler Egnede slokkingsmidler koordiner brannslokningstiltakene i forhold til omgivelsen! |
| 5 | water, foam, dry extinguishing powder, ABC-powder Unsuitable extinguishing media water jet 5.2 Special hazards arising from the substance or mixture Combustible. | vann, skum, slukkespulver, ABC-pulver Uegnede slokkingsmidler full vannstråle 5.2 Særlige farer knyttet til stoffet eller stoffblandingen Brennbar. |
| 5 | Vapours are heavier than air, spread along floors and form explosive mixtures with air. | Damper er tyngre enn luft, sper seg langs gulvet og danner eksplosive blandinger sammen med luft. |
| 5 | In case of fire may be liberated: Nitrogen oxides (NOx), Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | Ved brann kan oppstå: Nitrogenoksider (NOx), Karbonmonoksid (CO), Karbondioksid $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ Unngå innånding av røyken som oppstår ved brann eller eksplosjon. |
| 5 | Do not allow firefighting water to enter drains or water courses. | Ikke la slukkevannet renne ned i kanaler og vann eller vassdrag. |
| 5 | Fight fire with normal precautions from a reasonable distance. | Bekjemp brannen med normal forsiktighet på behørig avstand. |
| 5 | Wear self-contained breathing apparatus. | Bruk selvforsynt pusteutstyr. |
| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Use personal protective equipment as required. | 6.1 Personlige forsiktighetsregler, personlig verneutstyr og nødrutiner For personell som ikke er nødpersonell Bruk påkrevet personlig verneutstyr. |
| 6 | Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | Unngå kontakt med hud, øyne og klær. |
| 6 | Do not breathe dust. | Ikke innånd støv. |
| 6 | Keep away from drains, surface and ground water. | 6.2 Forsiktighetsregler med hensyn til miljø Holdes vekk fra avløp, overflatevann og grunnvann. |
| 6 | Retain contaminated washing water and dispose of it. | Forurenset vaskevann må holdes tilbake og kjø- res bort. |
| 6 | If substance has entered a water course or sewer, inform the responsible authority. | Dersom stoffet har havnet i et vann eller i kloakken, må den ansvarlige myndigheten varsles. |
| 6 | 6.3 Methods and material for containment and cleaning up Advice on how to contain a spill Covering of drains. | 6.3 Metoder og materialer for oppsamling og rensing Råd om hvordan søl kan begrenses Tildekking av kloakk og avløp. |
| 6 | Take up mechanically. | Opptas mekanisk. |
| 6 | Advice on how to clean up a spill Take up mechanically. | Råd om hvordan søl skal behandles Andre opplysninger om søl og utslipp Plasseres i egnede beholdere for avfallshåndtering. |
| 6 | Control of dust. | Det berørte området skal ventileres. |
| 6 | Other information relating to spills and releases Place in appropriate containers for disposal. | 6.4 Henvisning til andre avsnitt |
| 7 | 7.1 Precautions for safe handling Provision of sufficient ventilation. | 7.1 Forholdsregler for sikker håndtering Sørg for tilstrekkelig ventilasjon. |
| 7 | Avoid exposure. | Unngå direkte kontakt. |
| 7 | Avoid: Aerosol or mist formation. | Unngå: Aerosol- eller tåkedannelse. |
| 7 | Advice on general occupational hygiene Wash hands before breaks and after work. | Instruks for allmenn hygiene på arbeidsplassen Før pauser og ved arbeidsslutt må hendene vaskes. |
| 7 | Keep away from food, drink and animal feedingstuffs. | Må ikke oppbevares sammen med næringsmidler, drikkevarer eller dyrefôr. |
| 7 | 7.2 Conditions for safe storage, including any incompatibilities Store in a dry place. | 7.2 Vilkår for sikker lagring, herunder eventuelle uforenligheter Oppbevares tørt. |
| 7 | Keep container tightly closed. | Hold beholderen tett lukket. |
| 7 | Observe hints for combined storage. | Følg instrukser for samlagring. |
| 7 | See also TRGS 510 (Germany). | Uforenlige materialer: se avsnitt 10. |
| 7 | Incompatible materials: see section 10. | Verne mot ytre eksponering, som fuktighet, UV-stråling/sollys, kontakt med luft/oksygen Særskilt utforming av lagringsrom eller oppbevaringsbeholdere Anbefalt lagringstemperatur: $1 5 - 2 5 ^ { \circ } C$ 7.3 Særlig(e) sluttanvendelse(r) |
| 8 | 8.1 Control parameters National limit values Ceiling-C Ceiling value is a limit value above which exposure should not occur H Absorbed through the skin Inhalable fraction va As vapours and aerosols Human health values Environmental values 8.2 Exposure controls Individual protection measures (personal protective equipment) Eye/face protection Use safety goggle with side protection. | Kjemikaliehansker testet i henhold til EN 374 er egnet. |
| 8 | Skin protection • hand protection Wear suitable gloves. | Ved spesiell bruk anbefales det å avklare kjemikalieholdbarheten til de vernehanskene som ble nevnt ovenfor med hanskeprodusenten. |
| 8 | Chemical protection gloves are suitable, which are tested according to EN 374. | Tider er omtrentlige verdier fra målinger ved $2 2 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ og permanent kontakt. |
| 8 | For special purposes, it is recommended to check the resistance to chemicals of the protective gloves mentioned above together with the supplier of these gloves. | Økte temperaturer på grunn av oppvarmede stoffer, kroppsvarme etc. |
| 8 | The times are approximate values from measurements at $2 2 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ and permanent contact. | og en reduksjon av effektiv lagtykkelse ved strekking kan føre til en betydelig reduksjon av gjennombruddetiden. |
| 8 | Increased temperatures due to heated substances, body heat etc. | Hvis du er i tvil, kontakt produsenten. |
| 8 | and a reduction of the effective layer thickness by stretching can lead to a considerable reduction of the breakthrough time. | Ved en 1,5 ganger større / mindre lagtykkelse blir den respektive gjennombruddstid fordoblet / halvert. |
| 8 | If in doubt, contact manufacturer. | Dataene gjelder bare for det rene stoffet. |
| 8 | 1.5 times larger / smaller layer thickness, the respective breakthrough time is doubled / halved. | Når de overføres til stoffblandinger, kan de bare betraktes som en veiledning. |
| 8 | The data apply only to the pure substance. | Bruk av forebyggende hudbeskyttelse (hudkrem/salver) anbefales. |
| 8 | When transferred to substance mixtures, they may only be considered as a guide. | Begrensning og overvåkning av miljøeksponeringen Holdes vekk fra avløp, overflatevann og grunnvann. |
| 10 | The product in the delivered form is not dust explosion capable; the enrichment of fine dust however leads to the danger of dust explosion. | Produktet er ikke i stand til å forårsake en støveksplosjon i den formen det er levert i; men tilsetting av fint støv fører til fare for støveksplosjon. |
| 10 | Reactivity if exposed to light. | Reaktivitet ved lyspåvirkning. |
| 10 | Moisture-sensitive. | Fuktighetsømfintlig. |
| 10 | Hygroscopic solid. | Hygroskopisk fast stoff. |
| 10 | Keep away from heat. | Må ikke utsettes for varme. |
| 10 | Decompostion takes place from temperatures above: ${ } > 2 0 0 ~ ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ at 1.013 hPa. | Nedbryting finner sted ved temperaturer fra: ${ \tt > } 2 0 0 ^ { \circ } \mathsf { C }$ ved 1.013 hPa. |
| 10 | 10.5 Incompatible materials copper, bronze, brass, zinc Hazardous combustion products: see section 5. | 10.5 Uforenlige materialer kopper, bronse, messing, sink 10.6 Farlige nedbrytingsprodukter Farlige forbrenningsprodukter: se avsnitt 5. |
| 11 | Acute toxicity Harmful if swallowed. | Akutt giftighet Farlig ved svelging. |
| 11 | Skin corrosion/irritation Causes skin irritation. | Alvorlig øyeskade/øyeirritasjon Gir alvorlig øyeskade. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as a respiratory or skin sensitiser. | Sensibilisering av luftveiene eller huden Skal ikke klassifiseres som innåndings- eller hudallergen. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as germ cell mutagenic. | Skade på arvestoffet i kjønnsceller Skal ikke klassifiseres som skadelig for arvestoffet i kjønnsceller. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as carcinogenic. | Skal ikke klassifiseres som kreftframkallende. |
| 11 | Suspected of damaging the unborn child. | Mistenkes for å kunne gi fosterskader. |
| 11 | Suspected of damaging fertility. | Mistenkes for å kunne skade forplantningsevnen. |
| 11 | May cause damage to organs (liver, blood, kidney, nervous system) through prolonged or repeated exposure. | Giftvirkning på bestemte organer ved enkelteksponering Skal ikke klassifiseres som giftig for bestemte organer (enkelteksponering). |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as presenting an aspiration hazard. | Giftvirkning på bestemte organer ved gjentatt eksponering Kan forårsake organskader (lever, blod, nyre, nervesystem) ved langvarig eller gjentatt eksponering. |
| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed vomiting, nausea, gastrointestinal complaints Causes serious eye damage, risk of blindness • If inhaled vertigo, headache, irritant effects, breathing difficulties • If on skin causes skin irritation, pruritis, localised redness • Other information Other adverse effects: Liver and kidney damage Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\mathsf { M } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ . | Farekategori Bestemt organ Eksponeringsvei 2 lever ved eksponering 2 blod ved eksponering 2 nyre ved eksponering 2 nervesystem ved eksponering Innåndingsfare Skal ikke klassifiseres som farlig ved aspirasjon. |
| 11 | 11.3 Information on other hazards There is no additional information. | Symptomer med hensyn til fysiske, kjemiske og toksikologiske egenskaper • Ved svelging oppkast, kvalme, mage- og tarmproblemer • Ved kontakt med øynene Gir alvorlig øyeskade, fare for blindhet • Ved innånding svimmelhet, hodepine, irriterende virkninger, pustevansker • Ved hudkontakt irriterer huden, kløe, lokal rødme • Andre opplysninger Andre skadevirkninger: Lever- og nyreskader 11.2 Hormonforstyrrende egenskaper Inneholder ikke et hormonforstyrrende stoff (ED) med en konsentrasjon $\mathsf { p \tilde { a } } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ . |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Beskrivelse av førstehjelpstiltak Generelle merknader Sørg for frisk luft. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Skyll/dusj huden med vann. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Hold øyelokkene åpne og skyll øyet med rikelig rent, rennende vann i minst 10 minutter. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | Ta kontakt med lege ved øyeirritasjon. |
| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Kontakt en lege ved ubehag. |
| 4 | 4.2 Most important symptoms and effects, both acute and delayed Irritation, Nausea, Vomiting, Abdominal pain, Breathing difficulties, Vertigo, Drowsiness, Narcosis, Loss of righting reflex, and ataxia 4.3 Indication of any immediate medical attention and special treatment needed | 4.2 De viktigste symptomene og virkningene, både akutte og forsinkede Irritasjon, Kvalme, Oppkast, Magesmerter, Pustevansker, Svimmelhet, Døsighet, Narkose, Tap av likevektsrefleks og ataksi |
| 5 | 5.1 Extinguishing media Suitable extinguishing media co-ordinate firefighting measures to the fire surroundings! | 5.1 Slokkingsmidler Egnede slokkingsmidler koordiner brannslokningstiltakene i forhold til omgivelsen! |
| 5 | water spray, alcohol resistant foam, dry extinguishing powder, BC-powder, carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ Unsuitable extinguishing media water jet 5.2 Special hazards arising from the substance or mixture Combustible. | vannspray, alkoholresistent skum, slukkespulver, BC-pulver, karbondioksid $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ Uegnede slokkingsmidler full vannstråle 5.2 Særlige farer knyttet til stoffet eller stoffblandingen Brennbar. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Beskrivelse av førstehjelpstiltak Generelle merknader Sørg for frisk luft. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Beskrivelse av førstehjelpstiltak Generelle merknader Sørg for frisk luft. |

| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Skyll/dusj huden med vann. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Hold øyelokkene åpne og skyll øyet med rikelig rent, rennende vann i minst 10 minutter. |
| 4 | In case of eye irritation consult an ophthalmologist. | Ta kontakt med lege ved øyeirritasjon. |
| 4 | Call a doctor if you feel unwell. | Kontakt en lege ved ubehag. |
| 4 | 4.2 Most important symptoms and effects, both acute and delayed Irritation, Vomiting, Dizziness, Drowsiness, Narcosis 4.3 Indication of any immediate medical attention and special treatment needed | 4.2 De viktigste symptomene og virkningene, både akutte og forsinkede Irritasjon, Oppkast, Svimmelhet, Døsighet, Narkose 4.3 Angivelse av om umiddelbar legehjelp og spesialbehandling er nødvendig |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Beskrivelse av førstehjelpstiltak Generelle merknader Sørg for frisk luft. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Skyll/dusj huden med vann. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Søk legeråd hvis du er i tvil, eller hvis det oppstår problemer. |

| 11 | May cause damage to organs (liver, blood, kidney, nervous system) through prolonged or repeated exposure. | Kategorie zagrozenia Narȩd docelowy Droga narażenia 2 wątroba w przypadku narażenia 2 krew w przypadku narażenia 2 nerka w przypadku narażenia 2 ukwart Nerwowy w przypadku narażenia Zagrożenie spowodowane aspiracją Nie klasyfikuje się jako stwarzająca zagrożenie spowodowane aspiracją. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as presenting an aspiration hazard. | Objawy związane z właściwościami fizycznymi, chemicznymi i toksykologicznymi • W przypadku połknięcia wymioty, nudności, dolegliwości żołądkowo-jelitowe • W przypadku dostania się do oczu Powoduje poważne uszkodzenie oczu, może spowodować utratę wzroku • W przypadku dostania się do dróg oddechowych zawroty głowy, ból głowy, skutki podrażniające, trudności w oddychaniu • W przypadku dostania się na skórę działa drażniąco na skórę, świąd, miejscowe zaczerwienienie • Inne informacje Inne szkodliwe skutki działania: Uszkodzenia wątroby i nerek 11.2 Właściwości zaburzające funkcjonowanie układu hormonalnego Nie zawiera substancji zaburzającej funkcjonowanie układu hormonalnego w stężeniu $\geq 0 , 1 \%$ . |
| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed vomiting, nausea, gastrointestinal complaints Causes serious eye damage, risk of blindness • If inhaled vertigo, headache, irritant effects, breathing difficulties • If on skin causes skin irritation, pruritis, localised redness • Other information Other adverse effects: Liver and kidney damage Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\dot { \geq } 0 , 1 \%$ . | 11.3 Informacje o innych zagrożeniach |

| 10 | There is no additional information. | Niebezpieczne produkty powstające podczas spalania: zob. |
| 11 | Test data are not available for the complete mixture. | Brak danych z badań dla kompletnej mieszaniny. |

| 11 | Shall not be classified as acutely toxic. | Nie klasyfikuje się jako toksycznie ostry. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as corrosive/irritant to skin. | Nie klasyfikuje się jako żrąca/drażniąca skórę. |

| 11 | Shall not be classified as a respiratory or skin sensitiser. | Działanie uczulające na skórę lub drogi oddechowe Nie klasyfikuje się jako działająca uczulająco na drogi oddechowe lub skórę. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as germ cell mutagenic. | Działanie mutagenne na komórki rozrodcze Nie klasyfikuje się jako działającej mutagennie na komórki rozrodcze. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as carcinogenic. | Nie klasyfikuje się jako rakotwórcza. |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as a reproductive toxicant. | Nie klasyfikuje się jako działający toksycznie na rozrodczość. |
| 11 | May cause damage to organs (thyroid gland) through prolonged or repeated exposure (if swallowed). | Działanie toksyczne na narządy docelowe - narażenie jednorazowe Nie klasyfikuje się jako działającą toksycznie na narządy docelowe (narażenie jednorazowe). |
| 11 | Shall not be classified as presenting an aspiration hazard. | Działanie toksyczne na narządy docelowe - narażenie wielokrotne Może powodować uszkodzenie narządów (gruczoł tarczycy) poprzez długotrwałe lub narażenie powtarzane (w przypadku połknięcia). |
| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\dot { \geq } 0 , 1 \%$ 11.3 Information on other hazards There is no additional information. | Kategorie zagrozenia Narȩd docelowy Droga narażenia 2 gruczość tarczycy w przypadku połkównia Zagrożenie spowodowane aspiracją Nie klasyfikuje się jako stwarzająca zagrożenie spowodowane aspiracją. |
| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Opis środków pierwszej pomocy Uwagi ogólne Zdjąć zanieczyszczoną odzież. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Po narażeniu przez drogi oddechowe Zapewnić dostęp do świeżego powietrza. |
| 4 | Rinse skin with water/shower. | Zasięgnąć porady lekarza w przypadku pojawienia się jakichkolwiek wątpliwości, lub jeżeli objawy nie ustępują. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Spłukać skórę pod strumieniem wody/prysznicem. |
| 4 | Irrigate copiously with clean, fresh water for at least 10 minutes, holding the eyelids apart. | Zasięgnąć porady lekarza w przypadku pojawienia się jakichkolwiek wątpliwości, lub jeżeli objawy nie ustępują. |

| 5 | In case of insufficient ventilation and/or in use, may form flammable/explosive vapourair mixture. | W przypadku niedostatecznej wentylacji i/lub podczas stosowania, mogą tworzyć łatwopalne/wybuchowe mieszaniny para-powietrze. |
| 5 | Solvent vapours are heavier than air and may spread along floors. | Pary rozpuszczalników są cięższe od powietrza i mogą rozprzestrzeniać się nad podłożem. |
| 5 | Places which are not ventilated, e.g. | Miejsca, które nie są wentylowane np. |
| 5 | unventilated below ground level areas such as trenches, conduits and shafts, are particularly prone to the presence of flammable substances or mixtures. | obszary natlenione poniżej poziomu obszaru gruntu takie jak przewody i wały są szczególnie narażone na obecność substancji lub mieszanin łatwopalnych. |
| 5 | Vapours are heavier than air, spread along floors and form explosive mixtures with air. | Opary są cięższe od powietrza i rozprzestrzeniają się nad podłożem i tworzą z powietrzem mieszaniny wybuchowe. |
| 5 | Vapours may form explosive mixtures with air. | Pary mogą tworzyć mieszaniny wybuchowe z powietrzem. |
| 5 | In case of fire may be liberated: Carbon monoxide (CO), Carbon dioxide $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ In case of fire and/or explosion do not breathe fumes. | Podczas pożaru mogą powstawać: Tlenek węgla (CO), Dwutlenek węgla $( \mathsf { C O } _ { 2 } )$ 5.3 Informacje dla straży pożarnej Nie wdychać dymów powstających w wyniku pożaru lub wybuchu. |
| 5 | Fight fire with normal precautions from a reasonable distance. | Gasić pożar z rozsądnej odległości z zachowaniem zwykłych środków ostrożności. |
| 5 | Wear self-contained breathing apparatus. | Nosić autonomiczny aparat oddechowy. |
| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | 6.1 Indywidualne środki ostrożności, wyposażenie ochronne i procedury w sytuacjach awaryjnych Dla osób nienależących do personelu udzielającego pomocy Unikać kontaktu ze skórą, oczami i odzieżą. |
| 6 | Do not breathe vapour/spray. | Nie wdychać pary/rozpylonej cieczy. |
| 6 | Avoidance of ignition sources. | Unikanie źródła zapłonu. |

| 6 | Retain contaminated washing water and dispose of it. | Zebrać zanieczyszczoną wodę przeznaczoną do mycia i ją zutylizować. |
| 6 | 6.3 Methods and material for containment and cleaning up Advice on how to contain a spill Covering of drains. | 6.3 Metody i materiały zapobiegające rozprzestrzenianiu się skażenia i służące do usuwania skażenia Porady na temat zapobiegania rozprzestrzenianiu się wycieku Przykrywanie kanalizacji. |

| 7 | Keep away from food, drink and animal feedingstuffs. | Zalecenia dotyczące ogólnej higieny pracy Myć ręce przed przerwami w pracy i po jej zakończeniu. |

| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed vomiting, abdominal pain, nausea, Causes damage to liver through prolonged or repeated exposure if swallowed, loss of righting reflex, and ataxia Causes serious eye irritation • If inhaled drowsiness, narcosis, vertigo, breathing difficulties, Inebriation Prolonged or repeated skin contact may cause removal of natural fat from the skin resulting in dermatitis (skin inflammation) • Other information Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\mathsf { f } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ 11.3 Information on other hazards There is no additional information. | Działanie toksyczne na narządy docelowe - narażenie wielokrotne Nie klasyfikuje się jako działającą toksycznie na narządy docelowe (powtarzane narażenie). |
| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Opis środków pierwszej pomocy Uwagi ogólne Zdjąć zanieczyszczoną odzież. |
| 4 | In all cases of doubt, or when symptoms persist, seek medical advice. | Po narażeniu przez drogi oddechowe Zapewnić dostęp do świeżego powietrza. |

| 4 | 4.1 Description of first aid measures General notes Provide fresh air. | 4.1 Opis środków pierwszej pomocy Uwagi ogólne Zdjąć zanieczyszczoną odzież. |

| 6 | 6.1 Personal precautions, protective equipment and emergency procedures For non-emergency personnel Avoid contact with skin, eyes and clothes. | 6.1 Indywidualne środki ostrożności, wyposażenie ochronne i procedury w sytuacjach awaryjnych Dla osób nienależących do personelu udzielającego pomocy Unikać kontaktu ze skórą, oczami i odzieżą. |

| 7 | 7.1 Precautions for safe handling Measures to prevent fire as well as aerosol and dust generation Keep away from sources of ignition - No smoking. | 7.1 Środki ostrożności dotyczące bezpiecznego postępowania Zapewnienie wystarczającej wentylacji. |

| 11 | Symptoms related to the physical, chemical and toxicological characteristics • If swallowed nausea, vomiting, poisoning effect on central nervous system can cause convulsions, laboured breathing and loss of consciousness Causes serious eye irritation • If inhaled cough, pain, choking, and breathing difficulties • If on skin causes skin irritation • Other information Does not contain an endocrine disruptor (ED) at a concentration o $\dot { \mathbf { \rho } } \geq 0 , 1 \%$ . | Nie klasyfikuje się jako stwarzająca zagrożenie spowodowane aspiracją. |
